howToApply: Visit the official website: https://punjabassembly.gov.in/public/jobs
Click on ‘Apply’ for the relevant post.
Enter a valid email ID and mobile number, then click ‘Get OTP’.
Enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number and click ‘Verify OTP’.
Fill in Basic Details, Contact Details, Category, Educational Qualifications, and other required information.
Upload scanned copies of recent passport size photograph (jpg, max 2MB) and signature (jpg, max 2MB).
Upload required documents including Domicile Certificate, Nationality, Disability Certificate (if applicable), Punjabi Proficiency Verification, etc.
Enter the Captcha, select the Declaration checkbox, and click ‘Preview & Submit’.
Review the information in the Preview section. Click ‘Edit’ if changes are needed, otherwise click ‘Confirm & Submit’.
Proceed to online payment by clicking ‘Pay Now’ and pay the fee using available online payment modes (UPI, QR Code, etc.).
Download and print the payment receipt and submitted application form after successful payment.
